svg.text: People Ops Shared Drive - Leave Policy + Screening Notes
Exported 2026-08-26 17:42 by hris-sync | Folder: /people/policies/q3-refresh
Policy excerpt: flexible work and leave
Doc A: PTO-Carryover-2026-final.pdf
Effective: 2026-09-01 | Owner: VP People | Status: approved
3.2 Employees may carry up to 40 unused PTO hours into the next calendar year.
3.3 Carryover above 40 hours requires documented regional legal exception.
3.4 Managers may not deny carryover solely because a team changed reporting lines.
4.1 Flexible work exceptions must cite role requirements, not manager preference.
Comment from 2026-08-19 draft
Old draft said 24 hours. Legal requested this be replaced with 40 hours.
AI answer shown to HR generalist
"Employees can carry over 24 hours unless their manager approves more."
Citation shown: PTO-Carryover-2026-draft-comments.docx
